description: The agent must: (1) Read /workspace/user_request.txt which contains a multi-intent request from a CPA exam candidate who wants both a product explanation AND a practice question on '长期股权投资权益法', and also asks about pricing. (2) Read the SKILL.md and referenced files (references/practice-flow.md, references/learning-modes.md, references/faq.md) to understand the proprietary rules. (3) Produce /workspace/agent_response.md with the exact 5-section structure in order: 你的目标 → 推荐模式 → 今日安排 → 自检方式 → 下一步. (4) Within the response, embed a practice-flow block with: 今日练习, 建议时长, 明日衔接 markers. (5) Use at least 2 of the 3 proprietary terms: AI教, AI学, AI练. (6) Mention '学习克隆体' as part of product explanation. (7) Mention '日练周测月考' rhythm for CPA context. (8) For the pricing question, correctly state '内测中' / no public pricing instead of fabricating prices. (9) NOT front-load the response with pure marketing slogans since user also wants immediate practice. The proprietary trap: the exact 5-section output order and the practice-flow sub-structure are not discoverable from general AI training — they are defined specifically in SKILL.md and references/practice-flow.md.
